gloss: assistant store manager; deputy shop manager

definitions.gloss: assistant store manager; deputy shop manager
definitions.explanation: The second-in-command at a shop or restaurant, who supports the {店長|てんちょう} and takes charge in their absence.

examples.japanese: {副店長|ふくてんちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{昇格|しょうかく}→昇格：08369_shoukaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was promoted to assistant store manager.

examples.japanese: ⟦{店長|てんちょう}→店長：30461_tenchou⟧がいない⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{副店長|ふくてんちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{任|まか}される。
examples.english: On days when the manager is out, the assistant manager is put in charge of the store.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧や⟦シフト→シフト：10934_shifuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{調整|ちょうせい}→調整：14839_chousei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{主|おも}に→主に：01607_omoni⟧{副店長|ふくてんちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧だ。
examples.english: Training new staff and adjusting the shift schedule are mainly the assistant manager's job.

notes:
The prefix ⟦{副|ふく}→副〜：03965_fuku⟧ (vice-, deputy) attached to ⟦{店長|てんちょう}→店長：30461_tenchou⟧ (store manager). The same prefix forms many job titles.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {副店長|ふくてんちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become assistant manager
- {副店長|ふくてんちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as assistant manager
- {副店長|ふくてんちょう}⟦{代理|だいり}→代理：03422_dairi⟧: acting assistant manager

OTHER TITLES WITH {副|ふく}:
- {副社長|ふくしゃちょう}: vice-president of a company
- ⟦{副部長|ふくぶちょう}→副部長：23994_fukubuchou⟧: deputy department head
- ⟦{副校長|ふくこうちょう}→副校長：23995_fukukouchou⟧: vice-principal
